title: eXc BetterInfo
description: Client-side HUD info: AppleSkin-style food details, a colour-coded overflowing health bar, and status-effect timers.
body:
# eXc BetterInfo

A lightweight, **client-side** HUD mod that surfaces the info Minecraft hides from you — food saturation, overflowing health, and how long your effects last. Works on any server (no server-side install needed).

## Food info
- **Saturation** is shown as a gold outline on your hunger drumsticks, so you can see your hidden saturation at a glance.
- **Held-food preview** — hold any food and the hunger *and* saturation it would restore is previewed right on the bar (pulsing).
- **Item tooltips** — every food item shows its exact **Hunger** and **Saturation** values, always on (no key to hold).

## Overflowing health bar
- No more towering stacks of heart rows. Extra health is shown as a **single row that changes colour** for each additional layer — cycling through 10 colours — just like Overflowing Bars.
- **Absorption** is kept separate on its own row.

## Status-effect timers
- Every status effect icon gets a **countdown** (M:SS) so you always know how much time is left — with **∞** for infinite effects.

## Notes
- Purely visual / client-side — no gameplay changes, no server install.
